entry_state: The dated schedule retains every cash, write-off and clearing origin. A nonrational original rate is enclosed using positive-receipt monotonicity, and the same rate bracket propagates through all dates. Numerical uncertainty is not a distribution over economic histories.
exit_state: Rate bounds preserve a shared loan history and cannot be mixed into journals. Contract modification and credit reassessment are separate; equal terminal wealth can hide a wrong interest basis. Legal release and asset-transfer conditions require their own evidence.
findings: The nonrational-rate path ends at cash 300 and profit zero; certified widths remain a numerical budget, not an exact midpoint rate. Interval endpoints are not jointly attainable journal values.
The modification reduces gross carrying by 10 before allowance reassessment. A later credit review reduces allowance further without itself establishing cure.
Cured and still-impaired histories have interest 10 and 9 with compensating impairment, then equal final wealth. The text retains origination SICR separately from recovery from impairment.
Payment 85 produces full derecognition in the separate example only with the admitted enforceable release. No new defect observed.
